messages:
Dina (CS): Morning — RetailCo POC blocked: reserved GPU pool provisioning in us-central2 fails with subnet allocation + quota. Demo scheduled EOD. Need a quick swarm.
Marco (Sales): RetailCo wants clarity: if we fallback to another region/our managed pool, will reserved pricing or commitments change? Also they need static egress IPs for their firewall.
Yuki (Eng Platform): Can you paste the provisioner error and any agent logs?
Dina (CS): Error from UI: 
```
ProvisionerError: allocation_failed: NoAvailableIPs: subnet 10.20.0.0/23 - available_addresses=0
Cause: quota_exceeded: GPU_QUOTA(project=retailco-prod)=0 in us-central2
trace_id: prov-ff12
```
Also agent log: `validate_network -> alias_ranges_required=true but secondary ranges missing`
Hassan (Infra): Looks like two separate root causes: (1) customer subnet is tight /23, not enough for alias IPs; (2) their GCP project GPU quota is zero. Both will block immediate reserve.
Pri (Security): If we consider cross-region fallback, confirm their CMK location. They use customer-managed keys and S3-compatible audit forwarding. Cross-region or managed tenancy will require explicit key policy grants or key replication.
Marco (Sales): RetailCo prefers staying in the same region for latency, but will accept our managed pool for the demo if egress IPs and CMK concerns are covered. They'll want a written note on pricing impact.
billing-bot: Note: Reserved capacity discounts apply only when a customer signs commitment and capacity is allocated under their billing account. Temporary managed allocations are billed on-demand plus a transient operations surcharge. Any migration to a reserved plan requires the reservation to be created under the customer's account before discounting applies.
Yuki (Eng Platform): Short-term options ranked by speed: 1) provision in our managed tenancy within us-central2 (fastest if provider capacity exists) — we can provide fixed egress IPs; 2) provision in nearby region (us-east4) and route traffic (low latency penalty) — need KMS and egress checks; 3) customer expands subnet & files GPU quota increase (slowest).
Dina (CS): RetailCo asked if we can provision in their project but with our capacity (i.e., we create resources in their VPC). Is that possible?
Hassan (Infra): We support two deployment patterns: (A) tenant-owned VPC with our dataplane nodes in their project (requires their subnet to accommodate alias ranges & quota) and (B) managed tenancy where our nodes run in our project and peer to customer VPC via VPC peering or private service connect. Pattern B is faster but requires data-handling addendum and KMS access.
Pri (Security): For pattern B (managed tenancy), we must: 1) have customer grant our service-account encryption/decryption on the CMK or provide a new key in our region; 2) sign the data processing annex; 3) confirm audit log delivery. I'll draft the minimum security checklist.
Dina (CS): They also asked whether a region change will cause any proration or require new contract signatures. Marco, can you handle contracting questions?
Marco (Sales): I'll check with legal/finance. My understanding: switching region itself doesn't change the discount if the reservation is created under the same signed commitment and SKU; however, if we use a managed tenancy temporarily or the reservation is created under our partner account, discounts do not apply retroactively. I'll confirm exact language and return with a short note for the customer.
provisioner-bot: Provision attempt #7 failed at 15:02 UTC for prov-ff12: no available IPs. Full logs: https://ci.internal/prov/ff12
Yuki (Eng Platform): Action items: 
- (Hassan) try ephemeral managed tenancy allocation in us-central2 and report static egress IPs if allocation succeeds (ETA 25m)
- (Yuki) run quick dev-provision in us-east4 to validate canary routing (ETA 45m)
- (Pri) draft KMS policy snippet for CMK grant and the short security checklist (ETA 1h)
- (Dina) send GPU quota request template and instructions to customer (ETA 10m)
- (Marco) confirm billing/contract implications for transient managed pools and cross-region reserve migration (ETA 30m)
Hassan (Infra): Quick triage commands I provided to customer: 
```
gcloud compute networks subnets describe retailco-subnet --region=us-central2 --project=retailco-prod
# check secondary ranges
gcloud compute networks subnets describe retailco-subnet --region=us-central2 --format=json | jq '.secondaryIpRanges'
# check gpu quota
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=retailco-prod | grep GPU
```
Dina (CS): Customer replied they will open a quota request but want the demo today. They greenlit managed tenancy for the demo only if we can: 1) provide static egress, 2) guarantee CMK access, 3) ensure logs stay within US region.
Pri (Security): For CMK access we can accept either: A) customer grants our service account decrypt/encrypt on their key in us-central2, or B) customer creates a new CMK in our account with a key policy granting their audit team access. I'll prepare both templates.
Marco (Sales): RetailCo agreed to transient on-demand billing for demo if we email a concise cost estimate (include 10% ops surcharge). Also asked if we can downgrade surcharge if they convert to reserved within 7 days.
billing-bot: Policy: transient allocations may be credited up to the reservation discount if a reservation is signed within a 14-day window and allocation is migrated to the customer's account prior to invoice finalization. Credit subject to finance approval.
Yuki (Eng Platform): I'll start orchestration for managed tenancy in us-central2. If anyone sees a new error, paste logs here.
Hassan (Infra): Update 15:22 UTC: managed tenancy allocation in us-central2 success; static egress IPs: ["34.123.45.67","34.123.45.68"] pending firewall allowlist.
Dina (CS): Sending IPs to customer and the GPU quota template. They're testing connectivity now.
Marco (Sales): I'll draft the short billing note and send to finance for pre-approval of potential credit.
Dina (CS): Closing loop: last update 15:40 UTC — managed tenancy pool provisioned, customer running demo; they filed GPU quota request; security team finalizing KMS snippet. Will update if any rollback or migration needed. :white_check_mark:
